name: reservation-alpha-gate
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; set +e; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.reservation-alpha.json > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/types.log" 2>&1; T=$?; bun test --timeout 120000 core/count-support.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/unit.log" 2>&1; U=$?; bun test --timeout 120000 research/bapa/reservation-alpha-public.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/public.log" 2>&1; P=$?; bun test --timeout 120000 research/bapa/reservation-alpha-direct.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/direct.log" 2>&1; D=$?; bun test --timeout 120000 research/bapa/counted-seed.test.ts research/bapa/existential-seed.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/compat.log" 2>&1; C=$?; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < reservation-audit/message.txt > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commitlint.log" 2>&1; L=$?; rg -n -F 'reservation owned witness capture/source' reservation-audit > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/exception-matches.txt"; printf 'types=%s unit=%s public=%s direct=%s compat=%s lint=%s\n' "$T" "$U" "$P" "$D" "$C" "$L" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/checks.txt"; test "$T$U$P$D$C$L" = 000000
